index.html.heading: Choose the book and resources for your acquisition stage
index.html.body:
Start with the book overview and chapter topics. If you have a live opportunity, use the business valuation checklist to organize seller earnings, price assumptions and open diligence questions.

Find current Buying Wealth listings on Google Play, or ask about book availability. A retailer search is not confirmation of a particular edition or price.

blog/business-valuation-checklist/index..title: Business Valuation Checklist for Buyers | Buying Wealth
blog/business-valuation-checklist/index..description: Organize a business valuation review before buying: seller earnings, buyer cash needs and open diligence questions. Explore the Buying Wealth resources.
blog/business-valuation-checklist/index..heading: Use the checklist alongside the acquisition reading
blog/business-valuation-checklist/index..body:
A valuation checklist organizes questions; it does not replace financial, legal or transaction diligence. Keep seller statements separate from independently supported records and assumptions that still need confirmation.

Review what Buying Wealth covers, browse the chapter topics, and check book availability if the reading fits your current acquisition work.
